_template_notes: Strict-canon fanfic. Aims to slot into existing published canon as plausibly as possible. canon_expert enforces against both the source franchise's continuity and this book's internal consistency. Use this when the goal is 'could pass for an official tie-in novel'. Cross-continuity list is typically larger than Elseworlds because drift is not permitted.
continuity: <EDIT_ME — the strict canon tier, e.g. 'main-continuity-only' or 'primary-canon'.>
continuity_description: <EDIT_ME — describe the strict canon boundary. Example: 'Only main-line published works count as valid source material. Expanded-universe side material, non-canon spinoffs, and parallel continuities are all out of bounds.'>
era_description: <EDIT_ME — narrow era window. Example: 'Set in the canonical three-year gap between Book X and Book Y; characters must be in the state the canon leaves them at the end of X and must arrive at the state canon requires them to be in by the start of Y.'>
narrative_register: <EDIT_ME — should match the established franchise voice closely. Example: 'The register of the better mainline franchise novels — clean prose that serves the story's pace, emotionally direct without being melodramatic, matches the published house style.'>
